g.text: H-101 OUTLET TRANSFER LINE TO C-101
1. Pipe/fittings/flanges per class B3 (CFU-000-PI-SPC-001); BW fittings ASME B16.9, flanges B16.5/B16.47A RF.
2. Hydrotest 82.4 barg per ASME B31.3 345.4 (vents at high points, drains at low points).
3. PWHT: YES - all thk (P-No.5B, B31.3 Tbl 331.1.1) 705-770 C. NDE: 100 % RT of BW; 100 % MT/PT of fillets; HB <= 241; 100 % PMI.
4. Supports: RS rest/shoe, GD guide, ANC anchor, SPR variable spring - tags PS-<area><seq>-nn.
5. Welds: dot = shop weld, crossed circle FW = field weld; spools <= 12 m for transport.
6. Transfer line rises continuously from manifold to C-101 - no pockets (2-phase flow).
7. Manifold symmetrical about C/L of heater: equal hydraulic length per pass.
8. Rack crossing above tier 3 on dedicated transfer-line support beams at bents x=96/102.
9. Formal stress analysis mandatory (API 560 terminal loads, C-101 nozzle WRC 537).
ISOMETRIC VIEW - NOT TO SCALE - DIMENSIONS IN mm, ELEVATIONS / COORDINATES IN m (PLANT GRID)

CAT 1 - T > 300 C & NPS >= 6; T > 200 C & NPS >= 1
